reviews.text: I had a great visit and interaction with a vet assistant at this location by the name of Hector. He was very patient and able to ease any and all of my concerns about my newly adopted cat. Thank you Hector!

I came to Bronx veterinary today on Eastchester Road . My dog Teddy seen Hector. Hector did a great job, loving and Kieran to my pet Teddy and great customer Service. Hector was very detailed. Loved it. Awesome experience thanks, Hector..

Staff is extremely pleasant. The wait was in reasonable time and vet was not over selling anything which was a fear. My peanut was extremely happy with his visit especially with assistant Hector. He did amazing handling Peanut ans great answering all my questions and concerns.
When i was seen by Hector and Dr Vyorst, their were knowledgeable and pleasant. They were professional at all times.   They took very care of my puppy Dolla.
Superior veterinary services. Both the Dr. Gilbert and Hector the technician were very helpful
Great service and prices the staff is very nice. Hector was great help today with my dog.

Always have a good experience with this vet been going to this location since they had it up the block of the train station,
Our nurse was hector who we had three times and always a pleasant to have take care of us and helps us with any questions
Also had Dr. Gilbert best doctor I’ve had the pleasure of talking too !!
Thank you Bronx veterinary center for taking care of my cats 🐈

Great customer service from the entire staff.
A special Big shout out to vet assistant Hector and Dr. Katz for their dedication and love for my lil pup.
Hector and Dr Loazia were amazing with my dog Neo.

I have 3 cats and a dog and all of them are registered here! my family and I have been bringing our pets here for a couple years and the staff is very kind and prices are honest and reasonable. If you are iffy about price/budget don’t hesitate to ask for an estimate! The wait time can vary, but you must keep in mind that every appointment before you has different needs. Id rather wait and know that everyone’s animals, including my own, are given the time and attention that they deserve instead of the vets rushing through appointments. This place is fantastic and I absolutely recommend requesting Hector(vet technician) and Dr. Luckow! They were both very kind and patient, they answered all of our questions, and they were overall so very helpful 🫶

We had a wonderful experience at Bronx Veterinary Center on Eastchester Road. Hector, the veterinary technician who assisted us, was incredibly kind, patient, and helpful throughout our visit. Dr. Luckow was equally wonderful and took the time to answer all of our questions thoroughly, making sure we understood everything and felt comfortable with the care being provided.

We truly appreciated how friendly, attentive, and professional they both were. It’s reassuring to know your pet is being cared for by people who are not only knowledgeable, but who genuinely take the time to listen and help. Thank you, Hector and Dr. Luckow, for making our visit such a positive experience. We highly recommend them!
I'm so glad I brought my pet to the Eastchester location. Hector was very attentive, as well as Dr. Katz! Thank you !!

This was my first visit to a vet, my older kids usually handle vet visits. I was thrown off by the requirement to pay for the visit at time of booking but it turned out to be completely legitimate so don’t let it stop you from booking with them. Afterwards I did receive an email with what looks like an invoice but it was just a breakdown of what other tests may cost due to the symptoms I described. You’re not required to pay it. It’s just so you’re prepared. We didn’t need any of the additional tests and the team didn’t even offer them. I was able to purchase the meds directly from them for what I feel was an acceptable and affordable price. Hector did a fantastic job of caring for my pet and getting her back into the carrier!  Dr. Vyorst was very kind and patient and thorough. Overall it was a very good visit and I would recommend them again. Fair warning, I went in for a sick visit and waited about 30 minutes so bring something to entertain yourself and your pet.
Made an appointment for hersey

Vets are great !  However the front desk personal needs to work on their communication skills and positive attitude. Nasty attitudes will not make concern pet owners feel welcome to get their pets checked or even trust the establishment.

Hector was absolutely awesome and full of knowledge.  Answered all our questions.  Very professional and courteous.  Dr. Luckiest is great…also a wealtof information and a wonderful sense of humor…he’s very funny and did a thorough checkup on our dog which was found in a compactor.  I, have another doggie that comes to the center.  💯% satisfied!👍🏼👍🏼👍🏼👍🏼

Took my doggy for the first time and the service provided was awesome they were very attentive and caring with him. Hector and Dr. luckow are the best, will be bringing my doggy back here again. Happy with the service stars
Hector and the team were very nice , they were clean and explained everything I needed to know very informational

From calling in to book an appointment to check in to the visit - has just been an overall smooth process! I could not recommend this vet enough!! Staff is extremely knowledgeable, friendly, and patient😊 huge shoutout to Dr. Katz for taking care of my girls and Hector!!! Thank you guys for what you do 💕 …

Since day 1 always treating us great…Dr.Katz is amazing and so is Hector and the front desk staff. He was very patient with our pets and also very professional. Our girls love it there. Thanks for all you do…
Excellent place to bring your 4 legged child for checkups and or other treatments. Wonderful staff once you enter. Thank you Hector & Dr. Miranda for making sure our Oreo stays healthy every year.

Got my cats neutered here. Vaccinated and microchipped. Best time to go first in morning and beginning of week for regular appointments. All staff very helpful and informative. In and out fast if early and on time. Good communication via Otto app or texting and flexible payment plan options through cherry if you qualify. 🙏🙏
I went without an appointment and they found me the nearest appointment to check my baby. Everyone is so kind, thank you so much ❤️❤️❤️🥺 …

I’ve been going to Bronx Vet Center since I got my pup 6 years ago, and I always have a great experience. There’s rarely a wait for services. As long as you have an appt, you’ll be seen quickly. Even if you walk in, they can typically see you in a reasonable amount of time.
One of the techs, Hector, has been very helpful and patient with me the last couple of times I’ve taken my darling to the vet, as I learn more about to expect with my pup’s health as he gets older. I know we don’t pick the techs, but if I can always have Hector, I’d be happy! He’s very good at explaining procedures, vaccines, etc. in simple terms for me to understand. Excellent place to go!

It was great. The staff are very nice. Very helpful. Explain everything by detail and I am very, very pleased with them. It’s a little expensive, But I like the way they treated my fur baby thank you to staff Hector and DR  did a great job

We came in for Rusty’s annual wellness exam, and we had a wonderful experience. The veterinarian and the assistant, Hector, were both very informative, patient, and helpful throughout the visit. Hector made sure we had all the information we needed for Rusty’s future appointments and took the time to answer all of our questions and concerns. He was very gentle and caring with Rusty, which we truly appreciated. Thank you both for making the visit such a positive experience. Highly recommend!
doctors and staff are absolutely wonderful and took care of my fur baby
My kitten 'Shadow' is healthy but just needs her ears cleaned.

This is my first time using this service, but I am very grateful to Daniel because he was very kind and gave me the confidence and security to put my kitten in his hands. I am very grateful for his attention.

So my cat came home in worse shape than when I took her.  She was an 11 year old cat.  I took her because she wasnt using the litter box for 3 days and was vomiting a lot.  I was advised to admit her and she would receive IV fluids, an enema and medication to take home.  In the report , it was admitted that there was a fluid overload incident which can impair the normal concentrating ability of the kidney, which can persist for several days and lead to dehydration, disorientation, loss of appetite, extreme thirst and life threatening complications, which is what my poor little baby girl was going thru.  I took her back by the next day after calling, then while I was in the waiting area I received a call from the office stating that what was happening was normal and that if anything I should wait till Sunday and monitor her.  Sunday this place was closed and my poor cat was in very bad shape so I took her to a 24hr hospital (Veg ER of Whiteplains) and like most places so desperate for money the situation wasnt much better.  I brought all the results of what happened here so that helped, but they also tried to request more tests of which I agreed to and paid for.  She was given proper IV fluids this time, but it seemed like the damage was done and there was not turning back for my baby.  We took her home and did what we could for her with the meds sent home, but at the end we had to take her to be euthanized because of an error and how these places do not work with you knowing the expense because there first focus is how much they can get from you.

I rarely leave reviews, but every visit to this office seems to come with some type of issue. I called twice before coming in to purchase flea and tick medication for my dog. The first person told me no because my dog hadn't been seen in over a year, that I should place an called back, and another staff member told me it was no problem and that I could come in.
When I arrived, the front desk refused to sell me the medication and insisted I needed an appointment. I explained that I had already spoken with someone who said I could purchase it and that I had found an active flea on my dog. I was also told the medication wouldn't work on active fleas, which is incorrect based on both my previous experience and what the supervisor later confirmed.
After asking to speak with a supervisor, he came out, immediately approved the medication, and confirmed it would work promptly if my dog had active fleas. Unfortunately, the front desk then changed her explanation of what had been said.
The lack of communication and consistency among the staff is frustrating. Between conflicting information, payment issues, and doctors frequently running behind schedule, this office has been consistently disappointing. I hope they improve their communication because clients and their pets deserve a much smoother experience. Front desk needs to be trained!

I take my dog to this veterinary because the staff is very friendly and patient towards the animals..the vet and assistant also very thorough with the check up and explain everything very clear..they also follow up by messaging about the wellbeing of my dog after getting vaccinated..Definitely recommend

Nice caring place for your pets.
This pet care center treated my beloved Shiba with kindness, compassion and respect during a very difficult time. They went above and beyond to make us feel comfortable and welcome. Our Shiba is in a better place and we would like to thank the entire staff for showing Shiba and us love when it was needed the most. If you love your pet this is where you should bring them.

Just Calling in @2:00pm for my cat. The phone rings like 25 times then it tells you the call my be recorded. Then it says you are number 3 in line. After almost an hour they told me to leave a message. They call them selves an Emergency Vet. If My Cat was having an emergency she would have been dead.
I was in the Eastchester location with other pets of mine and the staff sits their and lets the phone ring while they talk to each other about other life experiences. They Have an English Doctor that Cares more about Vaping outside then doing the rite thing for your Pet. The elderly Doctor That Started this place really Needs to Sharpen The Rules for the sake of caring for animals.
The English Doc. Mis diagnosed My other Cat and now he has cancer and had an emergency surgery Somewhere else. If they are not going to have Vets that truly care for animals they should close down.
To expensive a good job if you want to pay 900 to get your cat nurtured
I usually go here to get checkups and shots for my cats. If you enter here expect to wait at least an hour and a half. I just dont understand why its over $600 to spay my cat.

I had a fantastic first visit at Bronx Veterinary Center. Everyone from the front desk to the doctor was incredibly kind and professional, and took the time to break things down for me as a newer pet owner. I look forward to returning to this office for my cat's future health needs!
The staff here are very kind and professional.  I will continue to take my fur babies  here.
Small place and it be packed with dogs and cats. But they are very good with pets.

If you love your pet, please stay away from this office. My cat was tortured! SICK SOBS!

This place is extremely expensive for no reason. THE ENTIRE STAFF IS INCOMPETENT. The visit alone cost a whopping $430 with no clear action plan, poor customer service, and little to no communication afterward. I am still waiting to hear back from them and still waiting for clarity regarding my cat's condition and treatment plan.

Thank God I did not purchase the Trazodone through them. They wanted to charge me $29 for it, while another veterinary office charged me only $4 for the exact same medication.

I only brought my baby here because of an injury, and I was forced to seek another opinion because my cat is still limping and still in pain. Dr. Katz misdiagnosed my cat said she was fine! DR. KATZ NEEDS A TRANQUILIZER OR TO BE PUT TO SLEEP!

Dr. Katz was very condescending, dismissive, impatient, and frankly unpleasant in his approach. His staff appeared disorganized and ill-prepared. Their excuse for failing to provide proper discharge paperwork and medical clarity was that their system had been down for THREE PLUS DAYS. That is completely unacceptable for any medical office, especially one handling the care of vulnerable animals. Their system feels just as outdated as Dr. Katz's approach to patient care and communication.

To this day, I still do not even know my cat's accurate weight or why medications like amoxicillin and prednisone were included without a thorough explanation.

On top of everything else, I later realized they had provided me with another client's discharge information while I was trying to get clarity on my own cat's paperwork. That level of disorganization is deeply concerning. HIPAA VIOLATION AND THIS WAS REPORTED TO THE AUTHORITY! SHUT THIS PLACE DOWN!

It is incredibly frustrating dealing with poor communication, incompetent record management, and a lack of compassion while your pet is suffering and you are desperately looking for answers.

Appointments mean absolutely nothing here. Expect to wait as though you walked in without one. The level of care and communication toward pet parents is honestly unacceptable.

The only positive experience I had was with Dr. Angel, who handled my cat gently and compassionately.

Pet owners deserve transparency, professionalism, proper communication, compassion, and real medical guidance when their animals are hurting. Based on my experience, I would strongly recommend seeking care elsewhere.

Hector was very concerned and addressed any needs I had with my dog and made sure to keep me updated on any treatments or services needed at time of visit . Dr. Katz was also great . I highly recommend.
Hector and Dr. Perez are great. They took care of my Buster with love, and he felt so much better after his cortisone shot. Thank you! You guys are awesome!

TERRIBLE ! They let my cat die! I took my cat here for a regular checkup and they informed us she had early onset kidney disease. They did not provide any treatment or medication whatsoever. They changed her diet and sent her home. She quickly declined in health and went into kidney failure. DO NOT take your fur baby here if you want them to be neglected. Not to mention they have no structure, super unorganized, you will wait for hours because they don’t even take appointments. They need to be closed down !
I love them. ❤️ The doctors and the staff are all very caring and nice.
The entire team is wonderful. The staff Hector was very attentive and great with my cat, the same as Dr. Vyorst.
The vet is amazing and the staff is respectful and helpful and amazing the staff who help me and my sister name Alisha she is so nice and helpful and I’m glad she is amazing
Love the in-person service very respectful helpful. Thank you to Alisha for your patiences an tender care to my baby's
Hector was great. He was able to get my husky’s nails cut without stressing out my baby. GREAT JOB HECTOR.
The staff at Bronx veterinary center of westchester square are so amazing. JAK loves seeing everyone and they treat him so great!

I always feel comfortable coming to this location knowing how well me pets get treated. Hector has attended us and he is always kind and gentle towards my fur baby. I received great guidance on cat wellness.  His passion did not go unnoticed.

I BEEN GOING THERE FOR 11 YEARS AND MY LAST VISIT WAS NOT GOOD AT ALL.  3 HR WAIT ON 4.22.2026 IS 4.24.2026 THAT I LEFT THE DR MANY MESSAGES CONCERNING MY PET LEXI AND I STILL HAVE NOT RECIEVED A CALL.  $500.00 JUST TAKEN EASY AND ALL IS THE SAME JUST LIKE I WALKED IN WITH MY DOG. I ASK WHEN DR VOYST WILL BE BACK THEIR ANSWER WAS THEY DIDNT KNOW.  HOW DOES A STAFF DONT KNOW WHEN A DR THAT HAS BEEN THERE FOR SO LONG IS COMING BACK TO THE OFFICE.  MOST OF THE STAFF MEMEBER WERE REALLY NICE, BUT THE DR I WAS NOT HAPPY AT ALL.  I DONT USALLY DO THIS BUT I NEED TO SAY WHAT I SEE AND FEEL AND MY DOG WAS NOT TAKEN CARE OF THE WAY IT WAS EXPECTED.  SHE IS BACK HOME THE SAME WAY I BROUHGT HER IN THE OFFICE TO GET HELP FOR HER.
I ALSO FEEL WHEN YOU GOING TO CHARGE, DO IT ALL AT ONCE NOT SEPARATE EVERY TIME SOMETHING IS TAKING PLACE YOU GET CHARGE.

I had a great experience bringing my cat, Tigress, in for her visit. The entire staff was kind, professional, and made sure both of us felt comfortable from start to finish.

I especially want to give a huge thank you to Hector—he was incredibly helpful, patient, and attentive. He took the time to answer all my questions and made sure Tigress was calm and well cared for throughout the visit. You can tell he truly cares about the animals and the people bringing them in.

Tigress was treated with so much care, and that means everything to me. I highly recommend this vet, and I’ll definitely be coming back. Thanks again, Hector!

Hector was so sweet and patient with Tyler and my many questions. He was thorough without dragging on. Tyler is super anxious with getting his nails clipped and Hector gave him treats and made him feel at super ease. I was surprised Tyler didn’t freak out.
Thanks Hector!!
Thank you Hector and Dr. Vyorst for your service today with Marley Goetz. I appreciate your service and your dedication with the animals.

I had a great experience at Bronx Veterinary Center  Eastchester. The front desk staff, Rachel and Sasha, were very kind, welcoming, and helpful from the moment I arrived. They made the check-in process smooth and answered my questions with patience and professionalism.

Hector and Maji, who examined Max and Milo, were gentle, attentive, and clearly cared about my dogs’ comfort. They took their time, handled them calmly, and made the visit much less stressful.

Dr. Vyrost has been caring for my dogs since they were puppies, and I truly appreciate his continued support. He is knowledgeable, thorough, and always takes the time to explain everything clearly. I trust him completely with Max and Milo’s care.

Thank you all for your kindness, professionalism, and for always treating my pets with compassion. I highly recommend Bronx Veterinary Center Eastchester.
Great customer service and my baby feline 🐈 was handle great. Was happy with outcome of my visit.

I had a very poor experience at this veterinary center. This is my first time visiting this location and my appointment was scheduled for 12:30 PM, and I arrived five minutes early. The first red flag I noticed was the small waiting area, which had many pet owners waiting to be seen. This is particularly concerning when you have a reactive dog.

Every vet clinic I have visited in the past—Heart of Chelsea, BondVet, and Forest Hills Veterinary Care—has had ample waiting areas, and I have never encountered more than two dogs in the same space. Despite my concerns, I decided to check in and asked if I could wait outside.

After checking in and paying a $75 deposit (which no other clinic has asked for), I was then informed that there would be a wait due to the number of people ahead of me. I agreed to wait outside, thinking that I would only have to wait a maximum of 15 minutes, as that has been my experience in the past. However, I ended up waiting for an hour.

After an hour, I went back inside to speak with the administrative staff. I asked how much longer I would have to wait, but the staff could not provide an estimated time and mentioned that there were still several people ahead of me. I explained that I had only blocked off my work calendar from 12:30 to 2:00 PM because I did not expect such a long wait, which is not typical. The admin informed me that the delay was due to staff shortages. I told them that it was unprofessional to have such long wait times and suggested that, if they anticipated delays, they should have contacted me prior to my appointment to advise me to come in later.

I tried to find a middle ground by asking if a veterinary assistant could administer my dog's Cytopoint injection, and that I could return later for his remaining vaccines. My request was denied. Frustrated, I asked for a refund, as I was not willing to wait any longer, and it seemed that this establishment did not value the service they provided.

I encourage others to take their pets elsewhere—where both the safety of your pets and your time are respected. I heard that some people waited up to three hours to be seen, which is simply unacceptable. It’s normal to expect to be seen within half an hour of your scheduled appointment. I eventually returned to BondVet and received the normal level of service I was accustomed to.

I had a wonderful experience at the Bronx Vet Center of Eastchester. Hector the technician was very gentle with my cat Milky and took his vitals with ease. He was very caring with my pet. Dr. East is very knowledgeable and explained my pet's illness and procedures to be done with clarity. I highly recommend to go here for your pet's well being. They also keep there pricing reasonable.

First-ever vet visit for my new puppy. I will update the rating at every process so you know how it's going.
---------------------------------
Summary: Go straight to texting or calling them. No need to fill out the "New Client Form" on their website, they will not get back to you. Wait times are roughly around an hour. I would come in around 10 minutes before to get settled. The techs are great and are professional. My puppy was welcomed and all my questions were answered.
---------------------------------
(Monday, 3/9/2026) I filled out the "New Client" form and waited to be contacted.
(Thursday, 3/12/2026) Didn't hear back. You also don't get a confirmation email once you submit the New Client Form, so be aware of that.
(Sunday, 3/15,2026) I decided to see if I can somehow "sign up" since the person who referred said the staff them up to an "account"? What account I have no clue. I somehow found this page
(Monday, 3/16/2026) I called but the line was busy, so I decided to text. Texting was faster. They basically never even used or looked at the submitted forms because the first thing they did was ask if I had an "account?" and asked the exact same questions from the form. It looks like an appointment was made on the date I requested.
(Wednesday, 3/18/2026) They called me at noon letting me know that my appointment was cancelled due to an emergency. Turns out, the person on the text made the appointment on a different day that I asked (honestly, on me for not double-checking too) But I did like that they called 3 hours before. So if it was my appointment date, I would've had enough time to adjust my schedule so I'm thankful for that.
(Wednesday, 3/25/2026) We waited roughly around an hour to be seen. The techs were great with my puppy and the first vaccines were fine for her. Everything went smoothly. A bit more on the summary. Overall no issues.

BTW - This isn't my first visit with them, but it was for my puppy. From my last visit, they seem to be cool and had professional attitude so that is why I decided on them. I made this review because now it was personal and I wanted to be more thorough.
Hector was amazing with my dog Hendrix. He was very patient and explained the treatment to me.  He was knowledgeable.
Hector was excellent❤️

The service was great they have taken care of both my kittens wonderfully . The staff is friendly and the doctors are caring.  Its expensive to have pets in this day and age.  They are expensive but so is everywhere.
Great place took good care of my Rambo , clean place friendly workers

Our experience at the Bronx veterinary was a positive experience . We had Hector , we could not have asked for a better assistant.  He walked us through the entire process for our beloved dog Holly.
Hector was so accommodating, compassionate, patient, and professional. He made the process of euthanizing our dog less stressful.
Thank you to the entire staff, the Doctor, and mostly to Hector!
Fast service friendly

I'm very impressed with this place. The wait wasnt that long. The front desk staff are very professional and welcoming.
Dr Luckow and Hector were attentive to the needs of my fur baby. Highly recommend this practice!

Bottom line I do not recommend for any exotic pet. I don't think Dr. Ritchie has enough experience and I would not trust her judgment. If you can't diagnosis without imaging for parasites or respiratory issues or infection what is the point of coming here? Another thing they do not have any imaging for exotics so basically come here and spend $125 to have her listen to the basic vitals. Also when getting a fecal they should test for multiple parasites for some reason they only tested for Giardia... Just a waste of money. Marrissa Ritchie should not be qualified to deal with exotics.

Dr.Richie, didn't introduce herself when she walked in and literally walked out didn't explain anything and had the vet technician do that. I brought in my baby bearded dragon she checked the basic vitals and then gave me medicine for him because he bleeds a little after he poops. I really just wanted a fecal done. The medicine worked for a day he was back to bleeding. $30 for a follow up appt. My 7yr old leopard gecko needed more than that, her symptoms were fasting for some time and green poop, the appt was made 2 days before the appt and then confirmed the morning of the appt to be told 20 min before the appt via text that they do not have the tools to help my leopard gecko and that the doctor recommends I her to an Exotic hospital... while I was on my way there, I could have booked some where else and not wait these few days. But they made sure to tell me that there is a no show fee this morning LOL.

They also gave me a list of exotics I called two places off that list and they told me they don't even see exotics. My fault for wanting to go somewhere closer to me than going all the way to Manhattan but Manhattan it is.

First time coming here with my pet Peppi, and I enjoyed it. Front desk was very nice and quick when it came to registering my pet. The staff was very informative thank you to Jasmarie and Dr. Vyorst. They both made me feel comfortable when it came to discussing a plan for Peppi, and I will definitely be returning back. We have no complaints!!

Also a side note is make sure you come early to your time as it does get busy.
Great customer service
Héctor was great with my baby Lola and so sweet and well informes with all the questions I asked.
Hector is one of the best assistant here!! Handled my dog with care and love. Would definitely recommend this vet facility to anyone and everyone!! Very respectful and professional. 10/10 experience.

Quick shout-out to Dr. Luckow and Hector! They were both exceptional with my pit bull terrier, Ace. 🐾 Ace is typically cautious about the individuals with whom he is amicable, and I can assure you that he did not become enraged or growl at Hector or Dr. Luckow. They are extremely pleasant, gentle, and knowledgeable towards Ace and I.

This time, I visited in the evening and encountered a significantly shorter wait time. We were in and out of the veterinarian's office in less than an hour, which was fantastic! The wait time is typically significantly lengthier in the morning. This veterinarian is my preferred choice. 🤗
Experience was excellent! Hector and Alisha treated me with a care, respect and professionalism!

I really like love this place,  take both of my babies (cat and dog). They really show compassion and take the time to take care and give information to any of your concerns. Had an appointment today and Hector took care of my baby Smokey thank you to him and the Veterinarian for making it comfortable and smooth visit.

Hudson, our pup, has gotten the best care and attention, at Bronx veterinary. Everyone there has been incredible from start of appointment to finish!  Special shout out to DJ and Dr. Perez! They made sure Hudson was comfortable during his vaccinations and ear cleaning.  Highly recommend.

Hector was great!!! Very professional, caring kept me informed and explained everything to me and my dog Milo liked him!!!!! And Dr. Ritchie was great explained everything I really appreciated both of them will definitely going back whenever my Milo needs anything!!!!!
Fast and easy service with great quality. Thank you Hector for the assistance.

I came at a busy time so while the wait time was exhausting, the staff was amazing and accommodating. I came because of a year-long battle with an ear infection on my dog and Hector was super helpful and patient when I needed to take some time to place a muzzle on my dog. Dr. Katz examined my dogs ears and even did a quick check of his eyes when I asked about their condition. He was super informative on everything that I would be charged for and why they would be helpful. When I called my mom to explain the charges and what would happen, Hector helped me explain everything!
Hector & Dr. Randall are amazing !!
My cat Daniel received exceptional care from pancreatitis but the vet bill pretty much exceeded my limited budget. All I ask is that they contact FreshPet as I previously requested. Thank you.

I woke up to find my dog of 12 years had passed away, and it was one of the most heartbreaking experiences of my life. In a moment of shock and grief, I began calling several places for help. From the very first phone call, I felt compassion and understanding.

When we arrived, Mark took exceptional care of both me and my baby. He treated us with such dignity, patience, and genuine empathy during an incredibly painful time. Although I was not financially able to bring my baby’s ashes home, Mark went above and beyond in a way I will never forget. He created a beautiful keepsake box for me with my baby’s fur and paw prints — a gesture that brought me to tears and meant more than words can express.

His kindness, compassion, and humanity made an unbearable situation just a little bit easier to endure. I will forever be grateful. May God bless him endlessly for the comfort he provided during one of the hardest days of my life.

I would like to commend Dr. Vyorst and his assistant Hector for their exemplary service and professionalism. They showed empathy and patience in regard to the issue with our Beloved cat Princess today. They communicated the issue at hand and offered options which we highly appreciated. I highly recommend this establishment and wonderful staff.

Thank you Dr Vyorst and Hector,

Randy, Kaya & Princess 🐈

Thank you to Hector for going above and beyond with my girls always patient and attentive. Dr. Perez is outstanding with her level of knowledge and the care that she gives my girls all while knowing how crazy they can be.  They are the real MVP’s. Thank you. Always Lola, Leila and Marta

Your animal is always seen in a timely fashion the dr and vet listens to your concerns and takes time to explain everything. You always feel welcomed here and no surprise bills everything explained. Hector is always great
Dr. Luckai and staff members Jismely were great with my rottweiler Bless. I will schedule all my future appointments on the days that they are in the office.
Doc Luckow and Jismely were amazing. So knowledgeable and helpful. Took the time to explain everything. Prices are so reasonable. Thank you.
Friendly staff. quick and efficient visit to my cat.

I want to thank everyone for welcoming my Mason and myself. The front desk was amazingly kind, but the one person that stuck out to me was Hector, this young man was kind, compassionate and made sure I left with all the information I needed. Dr. Vyorst explained everything to me and what needed to be done, great doctor. If you can’t fully pay, there are pamphlets that you can apply that’ll help pay for your visits. I was approved for $2,000 ( Cherry ) Keep the good Work. Thank you Hector

We just went there today for our boy Wyatt and was taken care of by Hector and Dr. Vyorst. Hector was absolutely amazing. Very knowledgeable and friendly, and patient with our wiggly boy. Let me start by saying this was a place I used to take my dog—faithfully. I've had her since she was 10 weeks old, and she'll be fourteen in November. Yes, she's a senior dog.

This location had me completely messed up.

I took my dog here the other day for vaccines, a checkup, and possible bloodwork. I called beforehand and spoke to a woman who told me the checkup was $65, the shots were $55 each, and the bloodwork would be around $260. Cool—no problem.

We get there, and during the checkup, the doctor suddenly tells me the visit is actually $75, offering some BS reasoning: that it costs more since I’m doing bloodwork with the checkup instead of vaccines. Excuse me? That makes zero sense. The checkup is the same—there’s no magical difference in what she’s doing. She doesn’t perform a special trick just because my dog’s getting bloodwork instead of vaccines. (We’ll come back to that.)

Then she says my dog may no longer need vaccines and gives me a whole rundown. Again, fine. We settle on the bloodwork and the checkup. Total? $310.

Next, I ask, “When will I get the results from the bloodwork?” She replies quickly, “Tuesday!” So I say, okay, no problem.

But then—I have to pay before my dog is even taken in for this so-called bloodwork.

Then the groomer comes in, and here comes another scam. She’s like, “Oh, since your dog isn’t getting vaccines anymore, we can groom her here. It’ll be $130…” and says it like she’s giving me a deal. Then she tries to upsell me on extracting some anal glands or whatever. On top of that, she says I also have to pay for the fecal exam—another $40.

So, almost $200 just to groom my senior dog—at the vet—now that she’s not even getting vaccines?

Back to the bloodwork: we finish, and we leave. Monday was a holiday, so fine. Tuesday—no call. Wednesday—no call. Thursday—I call, and no one answers. I keep getting voicemail or getting hung up on.

Now I’m panicking. I’m texting, DMing them on Instagram like, why haven’t you called about the bloodwork? Why is that not your top priority?

Eventually, someone calls—only because I’m lighting them up via text. By now, I’m seriously questioning if I’ll ever bring my dog back there again. The service was awful. The customer care? Nonexistent. The whole experience? A disaster.

So I call another vet—and guess what the actual medical professional tells me? That if my dog won’t be getting vaccinated anymore, she should be groomed at home for safety reasons. It’s not safe to have unvaccinated senior dogs around other dogs.

Boom. This vet didn’t tell me that. You know why? Because they just wanted my money.

It’s not about your pet’s health, or your peace of mind as a pet owner. It’s about dollar signs. This place is a money-hungry scam. They don’t care about pets—they care about profits.

In the end, I found an amazing mobile groomer who is coming to my home to groom my dog—for $110. And I’m tipping him the extra $40 I would’ve wasted at that horrible vet.

I blocked them on everything. If I can’t reach you, now you can’t reach me either.
